# S340 — wave start: spec-check questions can only be answered on a terminal, one at a time

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave): with stdin not a terminal, `ork wave start` read each spec-check question's answer from stdin; an empty read held the item, and a held item's later questions were never printed (s454's changelog.wave-entries question only appeared after its first question was answered). The questions are not in `ork status` (needs you 0) or `ork show`, and unanswered ones are not kept, so each retry re-asked from the start. An agent driving ork had to pipe answers blind by position (`printf '1\n2\n' | ork wave start ...`), and running the same items alone changed the question set (s454 asked 1 question instead of 2). Wanted: spec-check questions recorded as needs-you questions (all of them, including later ones), answerable with `ork answer`/`adj answer` by key, and kept across retries.
